description: 6 independent constraints on one function — a reviewer/skeptic persona should catch the ones a single agent forgets.

input.message:
Write a Python function named `normalize_scores` that takes a list of numbers and returns a new list scaled to the 0..1 range. Requirements, ALL of which must hold:
1. Function name must be exactly `normalize_scores`.
2. It must handle an EMPTY list by returning an empty list (no exception).
3. It must handle the case where all values are IDENTICAL by returning a list of 0.0 values (no division by zero).
4. It must include a docstring.
5. It must NOT use numpy or any import.
6. It must include a comment line stating the time complexity as O(n).
Output the final code in one Python code block.
